Dumps selected links to a PCAP file, with one-shot or live capture modes.

# Purpose
This C file implements the `dump` action for a packet capture tool. It reads command-line options in [`dump_cmd_args`](<#dump_cmd_args>), then writes selected Tango link traffic to a PCAP file in [`dump_cmd_fn`](<#dump_cmd_fn>). The action can run in two modes: `--once` performs a one-time scan of the selected links and writes the fragments that are already present in the link `mcache`; the default mode attaches to the links and records new fragments as they arrive. The exported `fd_action_dump` object registers the action name, argument parser, execution function, and description.

The file also contains the callback logic used while streaming fragments. [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) copies fragment data into a buffered output area, [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) commits the packet to the PCAP file only if the fragment was not overrun, and [`during_housekeeping`](<#during_housekeeping>) handles clock refresh and periodic metric logging. The code tracks fragment and byte counts, detects overruns through `fd_metrics`, and uses signal handlers for `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM` to stop the capture loop.
